definitions.explanation: A flat piece of iron or steel. In cooking, refers to the flat griddle used for teppanyaki and other grilled dishes.
Something that is absolutely certain to succeed or be good. Colloquial slang derived from the idea of something being as solid and reliable as an iron plate.

examples.english: Grill meat on a hot iron plate.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{好|この}み{焼|や}き→お好み焼き：10252_okonomiyaki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{鉄板|てっぱん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Okonomiyaki tastes best when cooked on a large griddle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}{現場|げんば}→工事現場：26202_koujigenba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鉄板|てっぱん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{敷|し}かれていた→敷く：00366_shiku⟧。
examples.english: Steel plates were laid on the road at the construction site.

examples.english: This joke is a guaranteed hit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どれも→どれも：22934_doremo⟧{鉄板|てっぱん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧おいしい。

examples.japanese: ⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鉄板|てっぱん}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{間違|まちが}いない→間違いない：17813_machigainai⟧。
examples.english: This course is the go-to choice for beginners — you can't go wrong.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is the literal meaning used in cooking and construction. Sense 2 is colloquial slang popular in entertainment and casual speech, meaning something is absolutely reliable or guaranteed to succeed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS (sense 1):
- ⟦{鉄板焼|てっぱんや}き→鉄板焼き：10181_teppanyaki⟧ (teppanyaki — food grilled on an iron plate)
- {鉄板|てっぱん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ (to cook on a griddle)

COMMON PATTERNS (sense 2):
- {鉄板|てっぱん}⟦ネタ→ネタ：06309_neta⟧ (a surefire joke/topic)
- {鉄板|てっぱん}⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧ (a can't-miss menu item)
- {鉄板|てっぱん}⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧ (a guaranteed-good course/plan)

REGISTER:
Sense 2 originated in comedy and entertainment circles and has spread to general informal usage. It is not appropriate in formal writing.
